text:
## Purpose  
Establish procedures for detecting, investigating, and responding to security incidents (cyberattacks, data breaches, unauthorized access, system failures) to minimize impact and restore operations quickly.  
---

raw_entities.name: Cybersecurity Incident
raw_entities.description: A security event involving unauthorized access, malware, ransomware, or other cyber threats targeting bank systems or data. This incident type requires detection, investigation, and response procedures to minimize impact and restore operations.
context: Establish procedures for detecting, investigating, and responding to security incidents (cyberattacks, data breaches, unauthorized access, system failures)
security incidents (cyberattacks, data breaches, unauthorized access, system failures)

raw_entities.name: Data Breach
raw_entities.description: An incident involving unauthorized access to, disclosure of, or loss of customer or operational data. Data breaches are a critical security incident category requiring immediate investigation and regulatory notification.
context: Establish procedures for detecting, investigating, and responding to security incidents (cyberattacks, data breaches, unauthorized access, system failures)
security incidents (cyberattacks, data breaches, unauthorized access, system failures)

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Access
raw_entities.description: An incident involving unauthorized entry to systems, accounts, or facilities without proper authentication or authorization. This includes credential compromise and account takeover scenarios.
context: Establish procedures for detecting, investigating, and responding to security incidents (cyberattacks, data breaches, unauthorized access, system failures)
security incidents (cyberattacks, data breaches, unauthorized access, system failures)

raw_entities.name: System Failure
raw_entities.description: An incident involving system downtime, performance degradation, or operational failure that impacts banking services. System failures require rapid detection and recovery procedures to restore normal operations.
context: Establish procedures for detecting, investigating, and responding to security incidents (cyberattacks, data breaches, unauthorized access, system failures)
security incidents (cyberattacks, data breaches, unauthorized access, system failures)

raw_entities.name: Incident Detection
raw_entities.description: The initial identification and recognition of a security incident, data breach, unauthorized access, or system failure through monitoring, alerts, or user reports.

raw_entities.description: The systematic examination and analysis of a detected security incident to determine scope, cause, affected systems, and data involved.
